summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' using rotating string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotates n7gIxM by a dynamic count) with mangled identifiers, and is unrelated to the declared ESLint plugin purpose. The advertised package is an ESLint rule (lib/index.js) which has no reference to setup.mjs or math_init.js. The declared files manifest lists only 'lib', yet setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root — outside the author's declared files. package.json claims author 'ServiceTitan' but README is a 'TODO: description' placeholder. The alternate-runtime execution vector (fetching Bun to run the payload) is designed to bypass Node-based static analysis; installing this package on default `npm install` fetches an external runtime and executes an obfuscated payload of unverifiable behavior on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
